SCCI1.label: Content / Indexing

SCCI1.1.label: Document Missing from Scopus
SCCI1.1.description: Definition: A document is not found in Scopus, e.g. not indexed or delayed.

SCCI1.2.label: Journal / Source Not Indexed
SCCI1.2.description: Definition: The journal or source is not covered by Scopus.

SCCI1.3.label: Issue / Volume Missing
SCCI1.3.description: Definition: Some issues or volumes of an indexed source are missing.

SCCI1.4.label: Incorrect Document Data
SCCI1.4.description: Definition: A document record has incorrect details.

SCCI1.5.label: Duplicate Records
SCCI1.5.description: Definition: The same document appears more than once.

SCCI1.6.label: Awarded Grant Add Request
SCCI1.6.description: Definition: A request to add an awarded grant to Scopus.

SCCI1.7.label: Retraction / Withdrawal
SCCI1.7.description: Definition: A document is retracted or withdrawn and the record needs attention.

SCCI1.8.label: Missing Title / Metadata ("No title available")
SCCI1.8.description: Definition: A document record shows 'No title available' or lacks metadata such as title, abstract or references.

SCCI1.9.label: Title Re-evaluation / Discontinued Source
SCCI1.9.description: Definition: The customer asks about re-evaluation of a source, or about a source discontinued from Scopus coverage.

SCCI1.10.label: Unknown / Not Stated
SCCI1.10.description: Definition: The content issue is not stated.

SCCI1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified at Level 1 as 'Content / Indexing'. Choose the Level 2 value from this group only. 'Content / Indexing' means: Definition: Missing documents/journals/issues, incorrect document data, missing titles/metadata, duplicates, retractions (Content / Indexing)
